notes.title: RELEASE DAY
notes.notes:
It's finally here!
MY MAID GIRLFRIEND is NOW AVAILABLE!
All of us at Genius Inc. would like to thank you for your patience and continued support.
We hope you enjoy playing it!


We have received reports from some users that the game file cannot be downloaded properly. 
We have already fixed the issue and now you should be able to download the game. (Please uninstall the app first and try again.)
We sincerely apologize for the trouble. 
Please feel free to let us know if you have any questions regarding this issue.
